name: Botija (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of green, white and green with a broad white middle stripe, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Botija (a cross of Saint James and a jar on white and red).
history: Municipal flag of Botija; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Botija arms — cross of Saint James and jar (botija)
